Hi Phil —

Thanks again for the chat this morning. Quick follow-up: I tried to send the calendar invite for the technical deep dive (we penciled for next week) but I’m seeing it bounce for your address. Can you confirm whether phil@orchardhealth.ai is the best address for calendar invites?

If you didn’t get it, no worries — I can reissue. To make scheduling easier, here are two windows that work on our side (I’ve included CET conversions inline since you mentioned being in London):

- Wed Mar 9, 10:00–11:00 CET / 01:00–02:00 PDT (morning your time)
- Thu Mar 10, 15:00–16:00 CET / 06:00–07:00 PDT (afternoon your time)

If neither works, tell me 2–3 times that do and I’ll send the invite from my calendar with a backup dial-in and the bridge URL. I’m also CC’ing Karthik (SE) so he can join the deep dive and we can cover the integration checklist.

I attached a short agenda for the deep dive and a plain-text backup bridge in case Google Calendar mails come through funny for you.

Apologies for the hiccup — want to make this frictionless.

Thanks,

Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0182

Between those two windows the Thu Mar 10 slot at 15:00 CET looks best for our team. Can you hold that and resend the invite to phil.martin@orchardhealth.ai? We’ll have our Head of Platform (joining from Berlin) and one of our infra engineers on the call.

Also, could you include an alternate dial-in (phone + fallback link)? Our corporate calendar sometimes strips out embedded meeting links in forwarded invites.

—Phil
